description: Gen 1-4 Pokémon that have at least one Mega Evolution in the current games: the 44 classic ones (X/Y, Omega Ruby/Alpha Sapphire) plus the 13 added by Pokémon Legends: Z-A (Raichu, Clefable, Victreebel, Starmie, Dragonite, Meganium, Feraligatr, Skarmory, Chimecho, Staraptor, Froslass, Heatran, Darkrai). Cross-checked against PokeAPI pokemon_forms.is_mega at every build. National Pokédex ids.
